name: OpenTelemetry
summary: Export Ogun metrics and events as OTLP to an OpenTelemetry Collector or any OTLP backend, over HTTP on 4318 or gRPC on 4317.

fields.name: authorization
fields.label: Authorization header value
fields.help: Read from the exporter process environment, not Ogun's secret store.

settings.name: host
settings.label: Collector or backend host
settings.help: Host only: no scheme and no port.

egress.note: 4317 is OTLP/gRPC, 4318 is OTLP/HTTP. A collector on the same machine needs no outside reach.

notes: Metrics, sent as OTLP metrics: ogun.workflows, ogun.runs.active, ogun.approvals.pending, ogun.streams, ogun.node_instances by state. Events, sent as OTLP log records: failed runs and approvals waiting for a person.

implementation.evidence: Sink in ogun-export, written from public documentation and checked against a local fake in unit tests; not run against the real service.
